Hi! 

I saw you were doing creature designs a while back... Could I ask you for a design for a species of bipedal cats for a china-inspired part of my TRPG setting?

They are called Mao Guai (猫怪) and are about one meter tall.  No one is quite sure where they come from, but they tend to appear in human cities, and the popular theory is that they are cats that have become old enough to transform.

They are clever and nimble but lazy. They are often employed as house servants and messengers, but many live as beggars or thieves, or mooch off of a favored human.

I would like it if you could give them one or two distinctive traits that set them apart from ordinary cats, but otherwise, feel free to make them look like any breed of cat you like.

If you want to draw them wearing some type of chinese or china-inspired clothes, i would be very happy, but an unclothed version is fine too.

Thank you for considering this! Request more if the amount is not enough!
